name: woocommerce-claude
description: WooCommerce for Claude agent skills for store analytics, tax reconciliation, revenue, coupon, order and refund triage, catalog readiness, and MCP setup workflows

interface.shortDescription: Run WooCommerce store analytics workflows with Claude-ready MCP tools.
interface.longDescription: Agent skills for WooCommerce for Claude. Use them with a store that has the WooCommerce for Claude WordPress plugin connected over MCP to run weekly reviews, revenue-drop triage, coupon-performance triage, failed-order triage, refund triage, tax reconciliation, catalog audits, product content improvements, and store health checks.
defaultPrompt: Give me my weekly store review.
Revenue is down this month. Triage what changed.
Are my coupons working? Triage the last 30 days.
Triage my failed and on-hold orders.
Triage refunds from the last 30 days.
Reconcile my tax collected in the last 30 days.
